title: PCSO boosts healthcare services in Batangas through medical equipment donation

blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) continues to strengthen healthcare services in the province of Batangas through the donation of three essential medical equipment to the provincial government on November 5, 2026. PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles led the formal turnover ceremony of an ultrasound machine, a digital stationary X-ray machine, and an ultra-portable X-ray machine to Batangas Governor Vilma Santos-Recto at the Batangas Provincial Capitol. The donation was made under the PCSO’s Medical Equipment Donation Program (MEDP), which aims to support public hospitals and healthcare facilities by providing essential medical equipment.
